description: This file contains a static helper class 'BufferTestHelper<TValue>' used for testing buffer serialization in the Orleans.Serialization framework. It defines interfaces and classes to serialize and deserialize generic values using different buffer writer implementations, facilitating testing of buffer types and memory management.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper<TValue>
classes.description: Helper class providing methods and inner classes for testing buffer serialization of type TValue.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper<TValue>.IBufferTestSerializer
classes.description: Interface defining methods for serializing and deserializing buffer data.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper<TValue>.BufferTester<TBufferWriter>
classes.description: Abstract base class implementing IBufferTestSerializer for buffer testing, parameterized by buffer writer type.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper<TValue>.MultiSegmentBufferWriterTester
classes.description: Concrete implementation of BufferTester for the TestMultiSegmentBufferWriter type.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper<TValue>.StructBufferWriterTester
classes.description: Implementation of BufferTester for the TestBufferWriterStruct buffer writer.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper<TValue>.PooledOutputBuffer
classes.description: Struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> and IOutputBuffer for pooled buffer storage.

classes.name: BufferTestHelper<TValue>.PooledBufferWriterTester
classes.description: Implementation of BufferTester using the pooled output buffer.

methods.name: GetTestSerializers
methods.description: Creates an array of test serializers, each configured with different maximum sizes.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes a TValue input into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a read-only buffer into a TValue output.
